scope: MATTERIX local functional reproduction and modified planner validation, not author-identity reproduction or learned policy/OPD effectiveness.
intervention: For fixed-station waypoints use accepted local nominal joint branch; for source-dependent waypoints seed IK with that phase nominal posture. No physics, geometry, HSM thresholds, servo gains, speed limit, horizon, mass or success gate changes.

declared_differences: Local hollow vessel geometry and Panda standard gripper substitute for author CAD/Robotiq. Arm gravity compensation uses disabled link gravity.
N17 uses a local cup holder at107.05mm and parked front service panels with their collisions. This does not reproduce the author automatic door mechanism or original loading geometry.
N18 uses a220g rigid lumped vessel/load surrogate and a CPU empty-tared mechanical spring scale, not a liquid experiment or the unknown author scale implementation.
Phase-anchored IK is a disclosed local planner change; it is not original author code identity.
Shared-load PRO6000 CPU simulation differs from the prior TRX run; historical16/20 results remain separate, not pooled or replaced.

Legacy HSM joint-drive adapter is not the shared8D C3 student controller. Functional gates do not imply motion acceptance. Command acceleration peaks~84rad/s2 in modified runs; N17 new-bank position-second-difference peak~301.8rad/s2 at front_align remains open. These are120Hz position-derived diagnostics, not direct velocity sensor measurements.
The branch intervention groups source IK seeding and fixed-station anchoring; this experiment does not isolate their separate effects.
20 cases/task is a small nominal validation. Wilson95 intervals are reported per bank; same-bank paired runs and different tasks are not pooled as independent scenes.
known_preserved_failures: Original local baseline remains18/20 N17 and19/20 N18 on PRO6000; every failed case retained.
First N18 RTX replay finished57frames then failed in annotator detach with HydraTexture list; old log/video retained and separate clean render completed.
next_frontier: Port N17/N18 skills to the common C3 8D controller and qualify command/actual motion before learning or joint Robot RSI claims. Preserve the functional planner results as a separate reproduction baseline.
